Northwind Gene Therapeutics Announces Positive Topline Results from Phase 3 HARBOR Trial of NWG-301 in Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy

BOSTON, Mass., June 14, 2024 -- Northwind Gene Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: NWGT) today announced that the Phase 3 HARBOR study of NWG-301, an AAV micro-dystrophin gene therapy, met its primary endpoint, with treated patients showing a statistically significant improvement in NSAA total score at 52 weeks compared with placebo (p<0.05).
